page: Microsoft Azure EC96iads_v5 is a memory-optimized, isolated virtual machine configuration based on x86_64 AMD processors. Operating on Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance is allocated 96 dedicated vCPUs alongside 672.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core. As an isolated instance type, it runs on hardware dedicated to a single customer, avoiding multi-tenant resource contention.

Storage provisions include 3865 GB of local SSD capacity, integrated directly for low-latency operational scratch space, temporary storage, or caching tiers. The instance also supports Premium Storage integration for persistent disk attachments. There are no discrete GPUs configured on this hardware profile, and complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included by default.

From an efficiency perspective, the EC96iads_v5 packs high core density and extensive memory into a single hardware footprint, matching workloads where resource pooling reduces hypervisor overhead. Given its hardware isolation, dense memory footprint, and local high-capacity solid-state storage, this server is suitable for large in-memory databases, distributed data processing, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy transactional database workloads.
description: Microsoft Azure EC96iads_v5 is an isolated, memory-optimized instance running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. Powered by x86_64 AMD processors, it delivers 96 dedicated vCPUs and 672.0 GB of system memory, providing a high ratio of 7.0 GB of RAM per core. The server includes 3865 GB of local SSD capacity for high-speed temporary storage and is compatible with Azure Premium Storage for external disk volumes. With dedicated hardware isolation preventing noisy-neighbor interference and no GPU overhead, the EC96iads_v5 offers dense compute and memory capacity. It is specifically suited for memory-intensive enterprise workloads, large relational databases, in-memory analytics engines, and transactional database applications requiring local caching capability.
